verified_facts.text: The resort is a water village set in the Xixi Wetlands Nature Reserve in Hangzhou.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enter into an authentic water village set in the picturesque Xixi Wetlands Nature Reserve - a Hangzhou haven found near the west lake.

verified_facts.text: The resort is built in traditional Jiangnan architecture amid water village surroundings.
verified_facts.excerpt: Traditional Jiangnan architecture and serene water village surroundings create an atmosphere that captures the region’s heritage.

verified_facts.text: Xixi Wetland is a 5-minute walk from the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: Xixi Wetland: This scenic spot in Hangzhou is just a 5-minute walk from the resort.

verified_facts.text: West Lake is approximately 6.5 km from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: West Lake: The hotel is near the west lake, approximately 6.5 km from one of the most famous attractions in Hangzhou.

verified_facts.text: The resort is 7 km from the city centre of Hangzhou.
verified_facts.excerpt: We are conveniently situated just 7 km away from the city centre of Hangzhou, China.

verified_facts.text: The resort is about 43 km from Hangzhou Xiaoshan International Airport, approximately a 1-hour drive.
verified_facts.excerpt: The resort is about 43 km away from Hangzhou Xiaoshan International Airport (approx. 1-hour drive).

verified_facts.text: Lingyin Temple, the oldest Buddhist temple in Hangzhou, is around 5.5 km from the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: Lingyin Temple: The oldest Buddhist temple in Hangzhou, dating all the way back to the 4th century, is around 5.5 km away from the resort.

verified_facts.text: The Water Terrace Suite – King has a fireplace, a balcony and wetland views.
verified_facts.excerpt: A cosy king bed suite with a fireplace, balcony and wetland views

verified_facts.text: The Premier Water Terrace Suite has an in-room bathtub and a private spa treatment room.
verified_facts.excerpt: Spacious suite with king-size bed, in-room bathtub and a private spa treatment room

verified_facts.text: The Premier Water View Villa has a private courtyard and views of the wetlands or lake.

verified_facts.text: The Two-Bedroom Family Villa has a large outdoor jetpool, heated floors and deep bathtubs.
verified_facts.excerpt: With a large outdoor jetpool, gorgeous interiors, inviting bathrooms and two large bedrooms, this villa caters to both families and couples travelling together. With heated floors and deep bathtubs

verified_facts.excerpt: The Ambassador Villa celebrates your arrival with an exclusive In-Villa banquet served in the time-honoured tradition of Chinese feasts.

verified_facts.text: The Ambassador Villa is a three-bedroom villa set by a scenic riverbank.

verified_facts.text: Bai Yun is a Chinese restaurant serving authentic local Hangzhou dishes.
verified_facts.excerpt: A fine Chinese Restaurant serving authentic local Hangzhou dishes.

verified_facts.text: Afternoon tea is served aboard a traditional Jiang Nan sculling boat cruising the lake.
verified_facts.excerpt: Relish scrumptious savories and sweets, complemented by fragrant Chinese tea, as you cruise along the pastoral lake on a traditional “Jiang Nan” sculling boat.

verified_facts.text: Love Boat Dining on the waterways is available for lunch and dinner with a twelve-hour advance reservation.
verified_facts.excerpt: Love Boat Dining is available for lunch and dinner, with a twelve-hour advance reservation required.

verified_facts.text: The Banyan Tree Spa's signature Banyan Balance treatment uses locally sourced Longjing tea.
verified_facts.excerpt: Inspired by our poetic city, this experience harnesses locally-sourced Longjing tea, also known as the tea of emperors.

verified_facts.text: Wellbeing activities include baduanjin, biking and yoga.
verified_facts.excerpt: our calendar of activities — including baduanjin, biking, yoga and more — are an expression of harmony between self and nature.

verified_facts.text: The spa offers a leisurely Wetland Bike Ride around Xixi Wetland.

verified_facts.text: The library has a selection of classic novels and retro decor including an antique typewriter and a vintage phonograph.
verified_facts.excerpt: The library has an excellent selection of classic novels, and features retro décor including an antique typewriter and a vintage phonograph.

verified_facts.text: Guests can take a kayak expedition through the Xixi wetlands.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy the unique scenery of Jiangnan Water Town of Xixi through a kayak expedition with your family or significant other.
